newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Mayor taps ex-aide as transit head - paper.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Mayor taps ex-aide as transit head - paper.

text.p: Chicago Mayor Richard Daley selected Assistant U.S. Transportation Secretary Frank Kruesi to lead the financially strapped Chicago Transit Authority, the Chicago Sun-Times reported Tuesday.
Kruesi, a former Daley aide, would replace David Mosena if he accepts the position. Mosena resigned to become president and chief executive officer of the Chicago Museum of Science & Industry.
The transit authority board approved plans earlier in July to cut late night train and bus service and eliminate some bus routes to save about $25 million per year.
Even with the cuts, the transit authority projects continuing deficits without further cuts or more federal funding.
